videos.title: Heavy Attack Dragonknight Solo Build | ESO Update 51
videos.description:
Pure Class Heavy Attack Dragonknight Solo Build for ESO Update 51. Molten Armaments gives you Empower for 30 seconds, so you don't have to recast a Mages Guild ability every 10 seconds to keep it up like other Heavy Attack builds do. That leaves room to keep up more abilities. It's very easy to play, but damage is only a bit higher than Heavy Attack Sorcerer and a lot lower than Heavy Attack Nightblade.

This setup cleared Solo Moon Hunter Keep and Solo March of Sacrifices with 3 Misfortunes, and parses 59.4k DPS on the 6 million dummy.

Works for all kinds of solo content - overland at any Challenge Difficulty up to Vestige, World Bosses, Maelstrom Arena, Vateshran Hollows, early arcs in Infinite Archive, and Veteran Dungeon soloing.
